_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-07-14 · Session 115 (StarMagna) — the v0.6 doctrine re-seed → the graduation gate (before the whole-worklist batch-apply)
_status: Before we batch-apply the merge/mint doctrine across the whole worklist, we re-tested it. The doctrine (v0.6) was built FROM Sam's July-13 sitting, so we asked a blind AI pass (it only sees the doctrine + the courses, never the old answers) to re-decide the same 52 groups Sam walked — and it reproduced his fundamental 'combine vs keep separate' call 92% of the time, and correctly re-merged the 3 credit/noncredit mirror pairs it was built to fix. The finer call (merge vs package vs separate) came in at 87% — but every miss is a case where the doctrine has since gained a rule Sam's older answers predate, so the doctrine is likely AHEAD of the stale seed, not wrong. It's one ruling from graduating: settle whether the student-repeat test should merge same-college level pairs like 'Custodial Report Writing 1/2' (the doctrine says yes; the old guard said keep-1-and-2-separate). A fresh 52-group sample is decided and waiting for Sam's confirm marks. Wave 4 (2,000 more multi-college courses) is staged and can run in parallel — it doesn't depend on the gate.
